goal: Implement the 3 optimizations from speed-spec.md to achieve 10x speedup on simulate!(). All work on a dedicated branch. UInt16 mask (supports up to 65,535 materials). All GPU code through AK.jl.

stories.title: Energy loop fusion — fused polychromatic Siddon kernel
stories.description: Replace the sequential energy loop in _forward_project_poly!() with a single fused AK.foreachindex kernel that traces each ray ONCE through the UInt16 material mask and accumulates line integrals for all energy bins via a μ_table lookup. This is the primary optimization (10x on forward projection).
requirements: ALL work on branch 'speed/fused-projection' — create it from main before any changes
Mask type is UInt16 (NOT UInt8) — supports up to 65,535 unique materials/regions
μ_table is [n_materials × n_energies] Float32 array on GPU — up to 4000 materials × 30 energies = 480 KB
Use NTuple{N_E,Float32} for per-thread energy accumulators (register-resident)
N_E passed as Val{N} for compile-time unrolling
Implement tiled fallback (tile_size=8) for platforms where NTuple{30} causes register spill
Single AK.foreachindex over sinogram — replaces 90+ kernel launches
Include bowtie spectral transmission in Beer-Lambert sum (per-pixel per-energy)
Must handle PCCT path too (distribute via DRM after traversal)
ALL GPU compute through AcceleratedKernels.jl — no backend-specific code
Keep the OLD unfused code path available (gated by a flag or separate function) for correctness comparison
Do NOT modify main branch — all commits on speed/fused-projection only
acceptanceCriteria: Branch 'speed/fused-projection' exists and all changes are there (main is untouched)
New function siddon_fused_poly_project!() exists and is called from _forward_project_poly!()
Old unfused path still callable for A/B comparison
Sinogram output matches unfused version within Float32 tolerance (max abs diff < 1e-5)
Forward projection is ≥6x faster (tiled) or ≥8x faster (full NTuple)
mask is UInt16 throughout the fused kernel
μ_table supports up to 4000 materials
Works on Metal (Apple Silicon) via AK.jl
All existing tests still pass on the branch

stories.title: Separable Gaussian scatter convolution
stories.description: Replace the 63×63 2D scatter convolution with two 63-element 1D passes (horizontal then vertical). The Gaussian kernel is mathematically separable: exp(-(dx²+dy²)/(2σ²)) = exp(-dx²/(2σ²)) × exp(-dy²/(2σ²)). This gives 31x speedup on scatter. Keep 2D fallback for non-Gaussian kernels.
requirements: ALL work on branch 'speed/fused-projection'
Decompose 2D Gaussian kernel into 1D: Kx[di] = exp(-di²/(2σ²)), normalized
Implement _convolve_separable_1d_h!() and _convolve_separable_1d_v!() via AK.foreachindex
Add workspace buffers: ws_presignal, ws_scatter_temp (same size as sinogram), ws_scatter_kernel_1d
Guard: if kernel is not Gaussian (e.g., exponential), fall back to current 2D convolution
Apply to both add_scatter!() and correct_scatter!() paths
ALL GPU compute through AK.jl
Do NOT modify main branch
acceptanceCriteria: Scatter output matches 2D convolution within Float32 tolerance (max abs diff < 1e-6)
Scatter is ≥20x faster than current 2D convolution
Non-Gaussian kernel path still works (falls back to 2D)
PCCT scatter path also uses separable convolution
All existing tests pass

stories.title: Branchless DDA inner loop
stories.description: Replace the 3-way if/elseif/else branch in Siddon's DDA inner loop with predicated (branchless) arithmetic. Eliminates GPU warp divergence. Exact mathematical equivalence — same voxels visited in same order.
requirements: ALL work on branch 'speed/fused-projection'
Apply to BOTH the existing siddon_trace_ray (for unfused fallback) AND the new fused kernel from SPEED-BUILD-001
Use Int32 masks: mask_x = Int32(t_next_x <= t_next_y) * Int32(t_next_x <= t_next_z), etc.
Step all three axes unconditionally: ix += mask_x * step_x, etc.
Do NOT modify main branch

DDA inner loop has zero conditional branches (verify by reading generated code or profiling divergence)
